legacy.line: I miss Dad every day. I am also relieved that the hospital visits are over,
legacy.author: Kahlil Gibran
legacy.text: Long were the days of pain I have spent within its walls, and long were the nights of aloneness; and who can depart from his pain and his aloneness without regret?
legacy.reason: You carry both love that misses him and quiet relief that the hard hospital days ended.

legacy.text: Thus I ever lost my children without solace, and got them amidst fresh grief.....'
legacy.reason: You know how telling the painful truth can leave you feeling guilty and strangely heartless toward yourself.
